question: Using only Institutional Characteristics, which has better academic counseling services in 2024-25: Smith College or Mount Holyoke College?

answer.message: I can’t answer the original question reliably from the supplied sources inspected. Institutional Characteristics for 2024-25 has only one academic counseling field: a yes/no indicator of whether an institution offers academic/career counseling services. It says nothing about how good those services are, so it cannot show which of 167835 or 166939 has better counseling. At most it could show whether each institution reports offering the service. If both do, they would look identical. I also could not set up even that lookup here, because the analysis tools can only return numeric measures and this indicator is a coded field. No numbers were retrieved.
